captions.en: Local business owners want to use AI to bring in customers and have employees spend less time

captions.en: organizing materials and reports, and handle customer inquiries more clearly.

captions.zh: 这些具体的麻烦，就是我想帮大家解决的事。今年开始学习

captions.en: and delivered work too. I am still on this path, and my experience [unclear particle] is still building.

captions.en: Is the work returned reliable? Can someone be reached when something goes wrong?

captions.zh: 这些事都得说清楚。你每天忙着客户、员工和经理，

captions.en: application service providers, and encouraged service teams to be based at users' work sites.

captions.zh: 这跟我现在在兰州做的事是一个方向。放到咱们公司里，
